**Triage 定级(深读档)** · 2026-09-17T14:05Z · 分诊席 objectstack#6015 · R+273

- **`needs-user-decision`** —— 这是一次**章程内两条细则对同一个 PR 给出相反答案**,而按〈优先级〉两条同级、文本本身选不出赢家。⇒ 与本班 objectstack#18418 同形,而那一张**正是由维护者一句话裁掉的**。⛔ 分诊席不代裁章程文本,⛔ 也不替维护者选「更严」还是「更宽」。
- **车道 `domain:skills`**(受管面 `SKILL.md`)· **`priority:p2`**。
- ⭐ **填报席的处置是对的,逐条**:按「两条细则冲突 ⇒ **按更严的一条行动并立卡**;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」执行,**同时在受影响的卡上写明自己走的是严解**。⇒ ⛔ 它既没自行放行,也没把两个 PR 晾着不说话。
- ⚠️ **给维护者的那一格,本席只把事实摆齐,⛔ 不加推荐**:两个 PR(#18530 / #18529)是 `Clause-②: no`、CI 绿或近绿、**diff 在 `packages/spec/scripts/**`** ⇒ **路径肢与声明肢都没命中**;而与此同时**契约复审档在账号层 429 拒绝** ⇒ **任何隔离达档复核今天都跑不起来**。⇒ 这两个 PR 能不能落,**完全取决于哪条规则治它**。
- ⭐ 本席要点明的一条:**这不是「等档位恢复」就能绕过去的** —— 若治它的是严解,那么 429 一天不解、这类 PR 一天不能落;若治它的是入队闸门那条,429 与它们无关。**两种世界里「等」的含义完全不同**,而这正是要一句裁决的原因。

⛔ 不认领、不派发、⛔ 不代答。
<sub>本评论来自分诊座位</sub>

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with a recommendation (B: review existence unconditional, the limbs decide the tier); the maintainer answered with the rule above instead, adding that the recent skill edits had muddled it. The seat traced the muddle in `origin/main`'s history so the text can be put back exactly:

| commit | date | what it said |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `c47edbb2` (#17294) | 2026-09-10 | 「契约复审档留给 skills 席与 spec 席的条款②复核,其余席位 ⛔ 永不起该档子代理」「交付后复核由派发席席内完成:spec 席达档自审或派该档子任务,余席默认档自审加门禁」 — the lane rule the maintainer is restating |
| `05f1cdd6` (#18363, on #18349) | 2026-09-16 | re-keyed the three seat-bound lines to the served **tier** on the maintainer's 「不再有『只在 spec 席』」 — the seat list disappeared |
| `ab1d3592` (#18511, on #18434 ruling C) | 2026-09-17 | an off-tier seat may spawn the at-tier subagent — kept by today's rule |

⇒ Today's word restores the 09-10 lane key and keeps the 09-17 subagent route; the 09-16 「no seat list」 is superseded. The card's two readings dissolve under it: SKILL.md:637's limbs (path `packages/spec/src/**`, declaration `Clause-②: yes`) decide the **lane** — a PR that hits a limb is spec-lane work under the standing routing rule (a published contract surface is the spec lane's, whichever seat found it) — and SKILL.md:640's 「交付后复核」 applies **inside** the spec and skills lanes, where it is the at-tier review, in-seat or by subagent. Outside those two lanes there is no contract review to owe: the three landing pre-checks and the gates are the whole bar.

## Ruling

1. **Spec and skills lanes**: every delivered round gets the contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — in-seat when the seat's served tier is that tier, otherwise by spawning the at-tier review subagent (the fastest route, per the maintainer); the record is the same-shape comment on the PR or card with `Served-tier:`. The `needs:contract-review` carrier lives only in these two lanes.
2. **Every other lane**: no contract review. `Clause-②` is answered by lane routing — a diff on a contract surface (`packages/spec/src/**`; objectui `packages/types/**`, its schema corpus and the spec-pin coupling) is spec-lane work and moves there; a `Clause-②: no` PR outside those surfaces lands on the pre-checks and gates. ⛔ No default-tier 「self-review」 record is demanded, and ⛔ no other lane spawns the at-tier subagent.
3. **When the at-tier subagent cannot start** (the tier is refused or the model is unavailable — today's account-level 429): the review cannot be produced; the PR stays draft and out of the queue (the charter's safe state) until the tier returns. The maintainer's own review remains the only bypass, by their word each time. ⇒ PR #18530 / #18529 (cards #18010 / #18301, `domain:spec`, `Clause-②: no`, `packages/spec/scripts/**`) are spec-lane rounds and wait on the tier under rule 1 unless the maintainer reviews them.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:skills`, p2 stay. The claiming seat carries the rule into the governed text — `SKILL.md:637` / `:640`, `references/contract-review.md:26` / `:32` / `:50` (「按档位」 → 「按车道」; the fuse governs the spec and skills seats' clause-② review only; 「豁免仅独立性件与保险丝」 rewritten to say what is exempted from what), `references/core-rules.md` where the 09-16 re-key landed, and the machine side (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` / `check-clause2-carriers.mjs`, which `c47edbb2` keyed by seat and `05f1cdd6` re-keyed by tier) — the lane becomes the key again, the subagent route stays. Governed surface ⇒ human merge by the approver. After it lands, each lane seat re-reads the `needs:contract-review` carriers hung outside the spec/skills lanes (census in the director's ledger ⑫) and either re-lanes the item to spec or strips the carrier; ⛔ the director strips none before the text.
